Our client, based in Mechelen, is an international leader in medical imaging. You will join a modern and people-oriented working environment where quality, collaboration, and personal development are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

Would you like to work for an international company where technology and healthcare come together?

As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.

• Provide technical support to customers regarding software, hardware, and connectivity issues.
• Assist customers via phone, email, and remote support, primarily in French.
• Analyse technical issues and work together with customers to find the most suitable solution.
• Guide customers through software installations, updates, and configurations.
• Accurately register and follow up on support requests in the CRM system.
• Escalate more complex issues to specialised colleagues when necessary.
• Work closely with colleagues and other internal departments to resolve complex technical queries.

Who are we looking for?

• You have initial experience in Technical Support, Customer Support, or an IT Help Desk role.
• You have a strong interest in software, IT, and technology.
• You are fluent in both French and English, both spoken and written, as you will use these languages daily when communicating with customers and colleagues.
• You are solution-oriented and remain organised when dealing with multiple requests at the same time.
• You are able to prioritise effectively and manage your workload efficiently.
• A secondary education diploma (A2 level) is sufficient. Above all, we value your motivation, eagerness to learn, and passion for technology.

Where Italian nostalgia meets real hospitality leadership
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example during service, keeps the room running like clockwork, and makes sure every guest leaves feeling like they just had dinner at home.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Welcome guests and set the tone for the evening 

• Take orders and serve with precision, even when it's slammed 

• Own the floor during service — pace, table turns, team energy, guest happiness 

• Coach and steady the team in real time; step in and solve problems before guests notice them 

• Be the calm, capable presence management can count on when it gets busy  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A natural feel for service and a bit of leadership instinct 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, solutions over excuses 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €16.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real responsibility on the floor from day one — with a clear path to become manager within your first 6 to 12 months 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

Some people wait for opportunities.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Description

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have: 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly: 
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

Waiter / Service Responsible – Brusketta (Antwerp)
 

Brusketta is a Neapolitan restaurant on Jan van Rijswijcklaan in Antwerp, known for its energetic, always-busy atmosphere. We’re looking for a Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example, keeps a busy room running smoothly and makes every guest feel looked after.
 

What you’ll do
 
 

• Welcome guests, take orders accurately and advise on dishes and wines 

• Serve efficiently, even when the restaurant and terrace are full 

• Lead the floor during service: divide tasks, keep the pace and motivate the team 

• Keep communication between floor, bar and kitchen clear 

• Solve problems calmly before guests notice them 

• Make sure service standards and opening/closing routines are followed  

Who you are
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A strong service mindset with natural leadership qualities 

• Energized by a busy restaurant, organized and hands-on 

• English and basic Dutch required; Italian or French is a plus  

What we offer
 
 

• Full-time contract, 38 hours per week 

• €16–€18 brutto per hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• 2 days off per week  

• Real responsibility from day one in a growing restaurant group  

 Send your CV, a photo and a short introduction to 
hr@lvpgroup.be.

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Financial & Business Controller (M/V/X) - Region Antwerp

Our client is an entrepreneurial investment-focused organization with activities across long-term investing and financial services.

The company combines a strategic, hands-on approach with a strong focus on sustainable growth, financial discipline, and value creation.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as Financial & Business Controller (M/V/X) include:

• You oversee the financial performance of the organization's investment and financial services activities, ensuring timely, accurate, and decision-relevant reporting.
• You coordinate annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning, while challenging assumptions and tracking performance against objectives.
• You define, monitor, and analyze financial and operational KPIs, identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and value drivers for management.
• You prepare and review business cases, financial models, scenario analyses, and benchmark studies to support strategic, investment, and financing decisions.
• You collaborate with the accounting team on monthly, quarterly, and annual closings, and contribute to statutory and consolidated reporting.
• You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc regulatory reporting and help ensure compliance with applicable requirements and deadlines.
• You manage periodic reporting for key stakeholders and provide clear, actionable financial insights.
• You monitor cash flow forecasts and liquidity positions and support financing-related analyses and stakeholder interactions.
• You help strengthen internal controls and continuously improve finance processes, data integrity, and operational efficiency.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a master's degree in finance, Accounting, Business Economics, or a related field, combined with at least 3 years of relevant experience in controlling, audit, transaction services, investment analysis, or a similar finance position.
• You have a strong understanding of financial statements, performance management, and IFRS, and you ideally bring affinity with investment environments, financial markets, or regulated financial services.
• You combine analytical strength with a critical and solution-oriented mindset, and you know how to translate complex data into clear recommendations.
• You work confidently with Excel, and experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered an asset.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English and are comfortable engaging with both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
• You are proactive, accurate, and intellectually curious, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
• You bring additional value if you have experience with project management, internal controls, risk management, regulatory reporting, or financing projects.

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 
airline and MICE guests. 
Are you a commercial hunter with a passion for hospitality? Do you thrive on winning new business, building strategic partnerships and leading high-performing sales teams? We're looking for an ambitious Director of Sales to lead the commercial strategy of our international hotel. This isn't an account management role— 
it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll doYou'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by: 
• Leading and inspiring a team of business developers with a strong hunting mindset. 
• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 
• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 
• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships. 
• Using CRM and performance data to build a strong commercial pipeline and deliver measurable results. 
• With the help of a marketing officer and/or an agency, leverage digital marketing, content and social media to fuel lead generation, reinforce brand identity and support commercial growth. 
• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 
• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 
• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage. 
• Commercially driven, analytical and results oriented. 
• Comfortable using CRM tools and managing a structured sales pipeline. 
• Fluent in French and Dutch. English is a big asset.
